Author: Anmi (fork maintained by xMaboo)
Name: Beast Master Helper (BST)
Description: Tracks the Beastmaster quest chain and beast-catalogue collection progress, auto-recording captures from chat and offering navigation to quest and catalogue targets. Works with vnavmesh for same-map travel and Lifestream for cross-map teleports. An English fork of Anmi's Beastmaster plugin.
Punchline: Track Beastmaster job progress and your beast catalogue.
Changelog: Fixed Level Up Beasts rank scan - learns ranks whenever rank data is available.
